groups.name: Village Well
groups.notes: Reworked in 1.30.0 from a CT10 env improvement on the village tile (buried in the tile's improvements panel once built) to a standard construction blueprint (BpCMCVillageWell, same Construction subtab as the cottages/Hall) producing a CT2 structure on the village board. UID cmcimpwell kept from the improvement era so C# detection (VillageRenownPatch, VillageChroniclePatch, InnKeeperDialogSchedulePatch Ash arming, WellRemark/Housewarming dialog gates) is unchanged and an already-built well on an old save is expected to reload as the new structure card (runtime confirmation pending). Blueprint: research 192 ticks, discovery latched on Well Plans + cmcLocVillage on board (ConstantlyChecking false) + village phase >= 1 StatValues gate; location-locked to the Village via both BlueprintCardConditions and BuildingCardConditions; same five materials as the old improvement; BuildingDaytimeCost 12. Structure: UniqueOnBoard, CannotBeTrashed, Draw Water CI fills any tag_WaterContainer with 100,000 water (game caps to whatever room remains, so this tops off anything up to a Rain Cistern in one drag). 1.30.1 closed the plans lifecycle: the blueprint stage consumes cmcWellPlans x1 (DontSpend false, also blocks a duplicate second well), and the plans card carries a Discard DA (ReceivingCardChanges ModType 3) gated via RequiredCardsOnBoard on cmcimpwell - honored by DismantleCardAction.CanAppear -> CardsAndTagsAreCorrect, so it only appears while standing at a board with the finished well, making it soft-lock-proof; CannotBeTrashed retained as pre-build protection for the one-time dialog grant. 1.32.0 added a second one-time DA on the sketch, 'Re-face the Well', which used a runtime CardModel swap (WellArtPatch.cs, CardUtil.TransformCardInPlace) to retarget cmcimpwell to a second, otherwise-identical CT2 card (cmcimpwellcustom) carrying different art - meant to replace the vanilla legacy 'Well' sprite (visually a tropical-island holdover) with custom forest-themed art after the fact. 1.33.2 pointed cmcimpwellcustom at real art (CMC_WellPlans, the Inn Keeper's sketch) instead of a blank placeholder, but the swap still wasn't rendering the new sprite live in-session (visual cache didn't refresh from the CardModel swap). 1.33.4 removed the two-stage indirection entirely: cmcimpwell's own CardImageWarpData now points directly at CMC_WellPlans, so the well shows the correct art immediately on construction with no swap involved; cmcimpwellcustom, WellArtPatch.cs, and the 'Re-face the Well' DA were deleted as dead weight. Only the 'Discard the Old Sketch' DA remains on cmcWellPlans.
groups.evidence: T3.8 buildable PASS 2026-07-21; T2.48 art-choice re-face DA PASS 2026-07-30; 1.33.4 removed the two-stage art indirection entirely (simpler than what was tested, strictly safer)

groups.name: Village Area
groups.notes: 9 WorldMap nodes in a compact district east of the vanilla River Clearing. Village Path is the gateway hub (West across the bridge to River Clearing, gated behind the River Bridge improvement OR the Pathfinder perk). East spine: Village Path -> Highland Pines (20,0) -> Pine Trail (20,10) -> Village (20,20) -> Village Farm (30,20). South wetlands: Village Path -> Clay Shoal (10,-10) -> Sodden Hollow (10,-20); Clay Shoal -> Moss-Grown Clearing (20,-10) -> Foraging Forest (20,-20) -> back to Sodden Hollow, and Moss-Grown Clearing -> Highland Pines closes the loop. Foraging Forest is a vanilla Deer Grove clone; EnvironmentUID/LocationUID unchanged since 2026-07-16 so LostCatPatch/ProfessorSchedulePatch/DropInjections all still resolve. DropInjections.json adds drops to Farm and Forest by LocationUID. Highland Pines, Moss-Grown Clearing, Clay Shoal, and Sodden Hollow were renamed 2026-08-13 (from High Grove / Mossy Clearing / Clay Flats / Marsh Hollow) to stop colliding with vanilla location names of the same or near-same text; UIDs unchanged. (Note: this block predates the later north-spine addition - cmcEnvHuntersCrossing/cmcEnvDeerMeadow/cmcEnvBadgerWarren aren't listed in the cards array below; those were also renamed 2026-08-13, Deer Meadow -> Stillwater Meadow and Badger Warren -> Sett Warren, see README.md/MapNodes.json.)
groups.evidence: core travel/node PASS evidence is broad (T1.27 wildlife suppression, T1.44 flood-levee, T2.128 dup-terrain PENDING) but T2.77 FAIL (2026-08-15, portal-hub-env-overlap retro still open per summary.md Warning #5) marks the pre-bridge portal-arrival path as a confirmed unresolved edge case

groups.name: Village Farm - Seasonal Crop Fields
groups.notes: One harvestable crop field appears at the Village Farm per season via framework ConditionalDrops/SeasonRange in WorldMap/MapNodes.json (MaxOnBoard:1, ForceStay). Spring=Flax, Summer=Turnroot, Autumn=Rye, Winter=none. Each field is a single-UID CT2 card with a Yield stat (5760, -288 per Harvest = ~20 harvests) that hides its Harvest action when spent (RequiredSpecial3Percent + HideActionIfNotMet); no regrow, no destroy action, so it cannot become an infinite-food source. Out-of-season fields are removed by ConditionalDropService on arrival/day-rollover. Replaced the old bespoke VillageFarmSeasonalCropPatch (removed). Requires framework GameQuery.CurrentSeason fix (Season.SeasonID resolution).
groups.evidence: T1.12/T3.2 season-swap PASS 2026-07-21, but T2.82 (Partner-NPC harvest duty, 1.50.2) is marked PASS in the header while its own note reads 'Explicitly UNVERIFIED with a recruited Partner' - treated as unresolved, see Notes & Anomalies

groups.name: Village timeline - phase gate + Village Clock (PR-1)
groups.notes: Hidden GameStats cmcStatVillagePhase (0 undiscovered / 1 introduced), cmcStatVillageEpochDay (CurrentDay+1 stamped once at phase 1), cmcStatVillageWeek (derived weekly counter), cmcStatInnOnboardStep (anti-collapse beat sequencer). Phase 0: Inn Keeper's only StartingPoint is the 4-line intro chain (CMC_InnKeeperTalk_Intro -> _Money -> _Projects -> _Close; the close answer's ActionToPerform sets phase=1); all 35 other Inn StartingPoints + all 9 Professor greeting StartingPoints carry a phase>=1 RequiredStatValues gate; Professor gets a redirect StartingPoint (CMC_ProfessorGreeting_Redirect, listed first in the scene); both agents' TradingConditions require phase>=1; ProfessorSchedulePatch.RunScheduler early-outs at phase<1 (no wander/forage/specialty/specimen re-arm); Academy Study actions blocked with an 'introductions first' tooltip. Cottage/Hall blueprints re-gated from CardsOnBoard cmcLocVillage to StatValues phase>=1 with rewritten UnlockConditionsDesc. Village Clock (VillageClock.cs, ticked inside the existing InnKeeperDialogSchedulePatch 5s poll - no new polls): Week-2 line gates week>=2 + step 0, Week-3 backstory week>=3 + step 1 (each answer advances the step), errand offer week>=2, seasonal story pool week>=4 (C#), Ash arming week>=6 + Well + phase>=1 (C#) - no absolute-day gate survives. Save back-compat: phase backfilled to 1 on progress evidence (WellPlansGiven>=1 OR any QuestRenown>=1) or the Village Inn trait (explicit IsPerkEquipped check); InnFriendship deliberately NOT evidence - the phase-0 Chat DA builds it, so it would let one Chat skip the intro. Onboard step backfilled to 2 when Well Plans already given. A phase>=1 recap answer on the Start line replays the intro summary (CMC_InnKeeperTalk_IntroRecap).
groups.evidence: T1.13/T1.14/T1.19/T2.31 all PASS 2026-07-21/22, core VillageClock.cs mechanism; no later PENDING/FAIL against this specific gate

groups.name: Village Inn (permanent fixture, enterable)
groups.notes: The cmcInn entrance always spawns in the Village via framework ConditionalDrops/AlwaysTrue (MaxOnBoard:1, ForceStay) - PR-1 dropped the old HasPerk gate. The Village Inn trait (cmcperkvillageinn, StarsCost 1) is repurposed as a head start: StartingStatModifiers grants +5 cmcStatInnFriendship at run start, and VillageClock checks the trait explicitly (IsPerkEquipped) and backfills cmcStatVillagePhase=1 (introductions waived). Entrance is a vanilla-cabin-style CT2: 'Enter the Inn' DA produces the cmcInnInterior CT4 InstancedEnvironment card (FadeToBlack travel). Interior seeds an Inn Door (TravelToPreviousEnv exit) and the Inn Counter (CMC_MarketStall image). Counter DAs: Purchase Meal (2 DTP; Satiation/Hydration/Fullness/Calories), Stay the Night (32 DTP; Energy +60, Stamina +40) - both currency-gated by InnPatch (consumes Salt or Duros Coin, AfterWrapped); Work Odd Jobs (16 DTP; Energy -20, Stamina -15) pays 1-2 vanilla 50%-quality copper nuggets (Pk_5_1_8_SmithingGear_CopperNugget 7741ded7..., SD2=50/SD4=100) via pure JSON ProducedCards - no currency gate.
groups.evidence: T1.2/T1.8/T1.9/T3.5/T3.6/T3.7/T3.9 PASS 2026-07-21; T2.62 Inn-side deposit CI PASS/changelog-confirmed 2026-08-14 (LogOutput.log capture, 3 successful deposits)

groups.name: Village Academy (permanent fixture, course-gated blueprints)
groups.notes: The cmcAcademy entrance always spawns in the Village via framework ConditionalDrops/AlwaysTrue (MaxOnBoard:1, ForceStay) - PR-1 dropped the old HasPerk gate and RETIRED the Higher Education trait from character creation (CharacterPerkPerkGroup 'None'; asset kept so old saves stay valid). Study actions additionally require cmcStatVillagePhase >= 1 (AcademyPatch.BlockReason via VillageClock.PhaseAtLeast). Entrance 'Enter the Academy' DA produces the cmcAcademyInterior CT4 InstancedEnvironment; interior seeds Academy Door (TravelToPreviousEnv) + Lecture Hall. Six courses run as 2-hour study sessions (8 DTP, Energy -5/Stamina -4): course progress lives on the lectern's 8 generic DurabilityStat slots - SpecialDurability1/2/3 (Architecture 72h, Metallurgy 60h, Herbalism 30h) plus SpoilageTime/UsageDurability/FuelCapacity (Fishing/Armorer/Medicine, 24h each; CardData exposes 8 such slots total, not just the 4 Special ones). Each 'Study ...' DA adds +2h via ReceivingCardChanges ModType 1 and hides natively (RequiredReceivingDurabilities, HideActionIfNotMet) once one session remains; a 'Final Exam: ...' DA (also 2h, +2h) becomes visible for the last session and grants the hidden in-run Graduate perk via AddedInRunPerksWarpData (CharacterPerkPerkGroup 'None' keeps them out of character creation; requires framework 2.11.0+) - session split: 35+1 / 29+1 / 14+1 / 11+1 / 11+1 / 11+1. AcademyPatch gates tuition as a one-time enrollment fee (100, drawn from the Tuition Account balance) - deposits credit 2 Copper Coins (SD4=100 -> 50 each), 1 raw Copper Nugget (SD4=100 x2 unrefined multiplier -> 200, covers two enrollments), or 7 Salt (15 each, rounded up from the Copper Coin equivalent: 100/15=6.67->7) per CurrencyValue.cs - required and consumed on each course's FIRST session only; blocks re-study after graduating; CollectActionModifiers tooltip. AcademyCourseService (OnGMInitialized + post-course): for every run (trait check removed in PR-1), sets BlueprintModelStates=Hidden and UnlockableCards.Disabled=true for the gated blueprints unless earned, then unlocks earned ones via GameManager.MakeBlueprintAvailable - Architecture → WDI Sawmill+Grinding Mill; Metallurgy → ACT Copper Sheet; both → WDI Forge+Workshop Kit; Fishing → CMC Iron Fishing Rod; Armorer → ACT Copper Breastplate/Helmet/Greaves/Gauntlets; already-Available blueprints are never re-locked; missing mods are skipped. The Armorer course itself is pruned from the lectern's DismantleActions (AcademyPatch.PruneUnavailableCourses, via BepInEx Chainloader.PluginInfos GUID check) if Advanced Copper Tools isn't installed - Fishing and Medicine have no cross-mod dependency and are always offered. HerbalismForagePatch: GameManager.SelectCardCollection postfix duplicates Item-type CurrentDrop entries on 'Forage' actions when the Herbalism degree is held (execution path only, previews untouched). IronRodFishingPatch: an ActionRouter Before-hook mutates the shared Iron Rod catch-table weights in place (Nothing/Minnow suppressed, Crayfish/Perch/Eel boosted and pop-gate lowered) once cmcperkgradfishing is held. Pk_GradMedicine carries two PassiveStatModifiers (RateModifier -0.3/-0.2) copied from Perk_Trollblood's bleed-clot/ache-fade stats. Art: VillageAcademy/VillageAcademyInterior/VillageAcademyLectern/VillageAcademyFishing/VillageAcademyArmorer/VillageAcademyMedicine PNGs are white placeholders pending real art (prompts drafted in .audit/image-prompts-academy-courses.md).
groups.evidence: core enroll/study/graduate loop VERIFIED (T1.10, T2.36, T2.37, T2.43, T2.60, T2.61 all PASS through 2026-08-14), but T2.62's identical Academy-side tuition-deposit CI is still ARMED at LogInfo (never downgraded like the Inn side was) and the Medicine course payoff (T2.107) and Carpentry course (see separate group) are unverified additions layered on top

groups.name: Traits - Time-Based Perks
groups.notes: 4 perks are now data-driven hidden condition stats instead of the old TraitsTickHandler C# effects: each reads a vanilla stat (Light, Sheltered, MoonPhase) plus an offset only the perk supplies, implemented in Community_Mod_Chest/GameStat/CMC_TraitNyctophobia.json, CMC_TraitAgoraphobia.json, CMC_TraitLunacy.json and CMC_TraitDrunkard.json (the last shared with the Consumption Perks group below). Nyctophobia (night fear) shipped in CMC 1.68.25; Agoraphobia (outdoors stress), Lunacy (moon-phase stress plus Moon Urge) and Drunkard (sobriety craving) shipped in CMC 1.68.30. TraitsTickHandler.cs was deleted in 1.68.25: it resolved stat definitions instead of live stats, so every one of its effects was a no-op regardless of who held the trait, and its held-perk test read true for every character. CMC 1.68.35 (2026-09-19, player design from chiweichiwei): the four stats now show as ordinary hideable stats instead of alarms in the weather strip (StatusesHaveNoBar false, AlertLevel 0); Lunacy reads MoonShape with one status per moon phase instead of MoonPhase; Nyctophobia, Drunkard and Agoraphobia bands were redrawn; Insomniac's own status stat is retired (CMC_TraitInsomniac.json kept inert for saves) and the perk now speeds all four vanilla sleep-deprivation counters by +0.25, because vanilla chains the stages on exact counter values and speeding only some would stall it.
groups.evidence: built, not yet confirmed in-game. Rows T2.239 (Nyctophobia, gates the rest of the repair plan), T1.102 (Agoraphobia), T1.103 (Lunacy) and T1.106 (Drunkard craving) are all PENDING; T1.109 covers an existing save loading the fix with no migration step 1.68.35 redesign adds rows T1.115 (display), T1.116 (bands) and T1.117 (Insomniac chain), all PENDING.

groups.name: Traits - Consumption Perks

groups.notes: Cross-cutting: EncounterGuards/CMC_VillageNoWildlife.json (village-wide) + CMC_InteriorsNoWildlife.json (7 interiors) block the COMBAT; WildlifeIndoorGuardPatch.cs (new, 111 LOC) is a newer C# layer blocking the creature's ARRIVAL at an interior board in the first place (reported via a screenshot of a Bear at the Inn Counter) - the arrival-block half is the part still PENDING (T2.151).

groups.name: Village Tree Respawn
groups.evidence: T3.24 PASS, recorded via playthrough session 2026-08-08 (r15, copied 2026-08-09)
groups.notes: TreeRespawnPatch.cs does daily env-scoped tree regrowth across the mod's 12 WorldMap clone locations (later generalized alongside the stray-improvements fix, T2.122, 1.66.0). groups.name: Partner-NPC Integration
groups.evidence: T2.130 (indoor follow) PASS via r31 2026-08-27/29; T2.82 (field harvest duty) marked PASS in its header but its own note text reads 'Explicitly UNVERIFIED with a recruited Partner' - contradictory, see Notes & Anomalies
groups.notes: Cross-mod integration with vanilla's Partner-NPC companion system (not a CMC-original mechanic). PartnerIndoorFollowPatch.cs fixes a Partner not following the player indoors. The 3 seasonal Village Farm crop fields are JSON-tagged with the matching vanilla PartnerDuty_Harvest* duties so a recruited Partner can be assigned to harvest them, mirroring the vanilla flax field's own wiring.

groups.name: Village Founder Perk
groups.evidence: T1.21 CONFIRMED PASS 2026-07-30 playthrough - the acid test held: buildings landed on the player's HOME board, not the default River Clearing
groups.notes: 3-Star character-creation perk (StartUnlocked, StarsCost 3). VillageFounderPerkPatch.cs pre-builds village structures directly onto the player's actual starting board using the spawn-targets-current-board pattern (memory:reference_spawn_targets_current_board) rather than firing at an arbitrary time, which is exactly the failure mode this perk had to be built around.
